when.test: q.visibilityFilter.partition == null and q.taskType == null and q.filterField == null

choose.when: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(CONVERT(r.task_key USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY)) THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END FROM () r
choose.otherwise: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*)=COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(CONVERT(u.task_key USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY)) FROM () u) THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END FROM () r

mapper.sql: SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS due_group, CAST(COALESCE(due_at,'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') AS DATETIME(6)) AS due_sort, CAST(CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN COALESCE(created_at,'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000' END AS DATETIME(6)) AS created_sort FROM () b

sql.if: AND CAST(CONVERT(r.task_type USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY)=CAST(CONVERT(#{q.taskType} USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY)
AND =CAST(CONVERT(#{q.filterValue} USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY) LOCATE(CAST(CONVERT(#{q.filterValue} USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY),) > 0

AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM system_profile_workbench_task_visibility v WHERE v.tenant_id=#{q.visibilityFilter.tenantId} AND v.user_id=#{q.visibilityFilter.userId} AND v.deleted=0 AND CAST(CONVERT(v.task_key USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY)=CAST(CONVERT(r.task_key USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY))

AND (
<> OR (= AND
( r.due_group > CASE WHEN #{after.dueAt} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END OR (r.due_group=CASE WHEN #{after.dueAt} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AND r.due_sort > CAST(COALESCE(#{after.dueAt},'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') AS DATETIME(6))) OR (r.due_group=CASE WHEN #{after.dueAt} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AND r.due_sort=CAST(COALESCE(#{after.dueAt},'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') AS DATETIME(6)) AND r.created_sort < CAST(CASE WHEN #{after.dueAt} IS NULL THEN COALESCE(#{after.createdAt},'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000' END AS DATETIME(6))) OR (r.due_group=CASE WHEN #{after.dueAt} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AND r.due_sort=CAST(COALESCE(#{after.dueAt},'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') AS DATETIME(6)) AND r.created_sort=CAST(CASE WHEN #{after.dueAt} IS NULL THEN COALESCE(#{after.createdAt},'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000' END AS DATETIME(6)) AND CAST(CONVERT(r.row_order_key USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY) < CAST(CONVERT(#{after.rowOrderKey} USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY)) ) ) )

mapper.sql: ORDER BY DESCASC, r.due_group ASC,r.due_sort ASC,r.created_sort DESC,CAST(CONVERT(r.row_order_key USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY) DESC
